facts.fact: ITWeb Africa reports the Office of the Data Protection Commissioner issued an enforcement notice to the Business Registration Service over a breach exposing records of more than two million businesses, BRS complied, and the case was closed without a fine.
facts.system: Office of the Data Protection Commissioner
